create_sparse_multihead_attention: create a SparseMultiheadAttention module with custom stride and expressivity parameters for sparse self-attention
compute_checkpoint: compute the checkpoint index for a given word index using stride and expressivity settings
compute_subset_summaries: compute the set of summary word indices across all stride windows up to a maximum length
compute_fixed_attention_subset: compute the fixed attention subset for a word index combining stride window and summary indices
apply_sparse_mask: apply a sparse attention mask to attention weights to enforce the fixed factorized attention pattern
